Package com.HamesJoman.patient_portal.controllers

Class AppointmentController

java.lang.Object
com.HamesJoman.patient_portal.controllers.AppointmentController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/appointments") public class AppointmentController extends Object
REST Controller for managing Appointment entities via HTTP endpoints. Provides endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and cancelling appointments. Appointments are NEVER deleted from the database. Cancellations are tracked via status, and completed appointments are automatically marked FINISHED. All endpoints are prefixed with /api/appointments
Author:
Nathan Amidon

      @PutMapping("/{id}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> updateAppointment(@PathVariable int id, @RequestBody AppointmentRequest request)
      PUT /api/appointments/{id} Updates (reschedules) an existing ACTIVE appointment. Only ACTIVE appointments can be rescheduled â€” attempting to update a CANCELLED or FINISHED appointment will return 400. Request body fields (all required): date â€” "YYYY-MM-DD" startTime â€” "HH:mm" endTime â€” "HH:mm" patientId â€” int doctorId â€” int

    • cancelAppointment

      @PutMapping("/{id}/cancel") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> cancelAppointment(@PathVariable int id)
      PUT /api/appointments/{id}/cancel Cancels an ACTIVE appointment by setting its status to CANCELLED. Already-CANCELLED or FINISHED appointments cannot be cancelled.
      Parameters:
      id - The ID of the appointment to cancel
      Returns:
      200 OK with the cancelled Appointment, or 400/404 on failure
